domain: public-health exposure / bioaerosol station-day exceedance prediction (Japan, MOE Hanako-san automatic pollen-counter archive, 2003-2021)
prediction_question: For a Hanako-san automatic pollen-counter station (KH-3000 volumetric counter, hourly grains/m3), given that station's own hourly pollen counts through the end of day t-1 and the paired AMEDAS hourly weather through the same instant (plus calendar and station identity), will the station's day-t 24-hour total pollen count exceed a high-pollen threshold? RETROSPECTIVE BENCHMARK: the MOE terminated the automatic network on 2021-12-24, so this is a historical benchmark task on a closed archive, not an operational forecasting product; live pollen feeds are now private (tenki.jp, Weathernews) and are not used.
prediction_time: Prediction instant: 00:00 JST on day t (equivalently the end of day t-1). Features: hourly pollen counts at the station and paired AMEDAS weather, all timestamps <= 23:59 JST day t-1; no same-day values. Historical real-time availability: while it ran, the system published hourly updates (MOE press 4673: '1時間ごとに更新', real-time web display), so an operational user at day t-1 23:59 had all feature values. VINTAGE CAVEAT (recorded, not resolved): the archive is a post-season cleaned vintage - the in-file code -9996 explicitly marks values removed after comparing '前後の時間や周辺観測値' (neighbouring hours/stations), i.e. post-hoc quality edits a real-time user would not have had; blank/-9997/-9998 mark comms outage/Asian dust/snow outages. The task therefore claims NO historical operational availability and is labelled retrospective; the as-of policy is 'archive vintage, as downloaded 2026-10-28'. Station-eligibility for scored rows must be computed from a trailing pre-instant window (e.g. valid days in the last 14 days before t), never from full-season validity, to avoid future-conditioned inclusion.
target_definition: Binary: sum of the station's 24 hourly counts on day t (JST) >= threshold, with a censoring rule excluding day t from scored rows when fewer than 20 of 24 hourly values are valid (valid = non-missing per the in-file codes: blank = unobserved/comms outage, -9996 = other/unatural removed, -9997 = Asian-dust interference, -9998 = snow interference). Threshold OURS (construction decision): the archive publishes no daily category table for the automatic counters (the real-time site's 4-level colour scheme is not documented as numeric daily totals in the archive), so a base rate at a candidate threshold (e.g. a JWA-style daily-total level) is measured at construction, not asserted now. Units: grains/m3 (個/m3), volumetric KH-3000 counts; the MOE labels the real-time display 'スギ花粉数' ('for the time being, sugi pollen count') per press 4673 - whether the archive column is sugi-only or sugi+hinoki total is a documentation check at construction (single count column per station per file; no taxon split in the files). Label source column (day-t counts) is excludable from features by construction (features are strictly <= t-1).

split_strategy: Retrospective station-day benchmark on the closed MOE Hanako archive (program terminated 2021-12-24; no operational-availability claim - see prediction_time vintage caveat). Panel: station x day for the Feb-June sugi seasons 2006-2021 (16 seasons, 90-135 station columns/season, 7,813-13,221 valid station-days per season). Label: station-day 24-hour total >= threshold (construction picks from the measured distribution; candidate thresholds 40/80/160/320/640/1280 grains/m3 all recorded). Candidate windows (temporal, disjoint): train 2006-2013 (8 seasons, 90,423 valid station-days, 77,957 positives at 80), eval 2014-2017 (4 seasons, 45,832 valid, 39,624 at 80), holdout 2018-2021 (4 seasons, 48,947 valid, 39,626 at 80). Clustered effective sample = seasons (16), since same-day station counts within a region move together; season-level cluster counts must be reported with scores. 2003-2005 seasons excluded (layout unparsed).

measurements.probe_archive_2026_10_28: probe_archive.py (committed) -> evidence_2026-10-28.json: 16 anonymous requests total. Pollen block 113 files (2003: 1 region .. 2008-2021: 7 regions x 14 seasons); AMEDAS block 110 files (2005-2021). Kanto 2021: 3,600 hourly rows = 150 days x 24 h (2021-02-01 through 2021-06-30), 14-16 station columns, one count column per station, in-header missing codes (-9997 Asian dust, -9996 post-hoc removal, -9998 snow, blank unobserved).
measurements.national_2021_2026_10_28: 7 requests, 1,736,797 bytes, 4.01 s (coordinator, 4 vCPU container). Per-region station-name estimates (conservative suffix heuristic, undercounts): Hokkaido 1, Tohoku 10, Kanto 18, Chubu 20, Kansai 13, Chugoku-Shikoku 19, Kyushu 13 = >=94; literature says ~120 sites nationally (Kawatsu et al 2019 PMC6685964; NBER w31593: '120 stations, averaging two to three per prefecture').
measurements.extraction_cost_2026_10_28: Measured one season's pollen block: 7 requests / 1.74 MB / 4.0 s. Full-panel ESTIMATE (arithmetic, labelled): 223 requests, ~55 MB, ~2 min on the coordinator class; .xls parsing for 2008-2016 needs a worker with xlrd.
measurements.novelty_search_2026_10_28: Web searches (recorded in notes.md s7): no packaged, split, scored ML-ready pollen benchmark on this panel or any national pollen panel found. Closest prior art: Krakow birch/grass category ML study (PMC12915917) - single city, minimal 2022-2023 dataset on OSF only, full data by email request; EUMETNET Munich low-cost sensor study (one campaign, 6,220 points); Luxembourg PolnPy on data.public.lu (scraped, 'License Not Specified'); Raleigh NC pollen (433 records, one sampler). Hanako data used academically for causal/descriptive work (NBER w31593 allergies-accidents; Tohoku DP TUPD-2026-010 pollen-suicide; Kawatsu et al 2019 phase synchronisations) - none ships a prediction task. Japan's live pollen FORECASTS are private operators (no forecast licence required under the Meteorological Service Act per watabi.org explainer), MOE supplies inputs only.
measurements.archive_format_split_2026_10_31: 64/113 pollen files are OLE2/BIFF .xls (magic d0cf11e0, 2003-2014), 49 are zip .xlsx (2015-2021). The 2026-10-28 sample (2021 Kanto xlsx) generalised only to the xlsx era; '14 seasons with 7 regions' over-counted the zip era by 7 (2008-2014 are .xls). BIFF parsing needs xlrd (used in worker job east-asia-measure-002; python:3.13-slim + pip install xlrd).
measurements.full_panel_counts_2026_10_31: Worker job east-asia-measure-002 (exit 0, 280.2 s total; pollen part: 113/113 files fetched, 115 requests, 100.6 s, ~28 MB; report: candidates/tw-typhoon-day-closure/probe/measure_report_2026-10-31.json). 2006-2021: 16 seasons fully parsed (stations 'series' summing 90-135 columns/season - one column per station, trailing legend column dropped per file), valid station-days 7,813-13,221 per season (24/24 valid hourly values), censored 18-36%/season (min 2009 18.3%, max 2012 36.0%) (-9996/-9997/-9998 codes and blanks), 0 incomplete. Positives per season at daily-total thresholds (grains/m3): >=80: 6,677-11,593; >=160: 5,773-10,446; >=320: 3,642-8,615. 2014 Hokkaido quartiles [4, 72, 148, 387, 2428]; 2021 Kanto [0, 168, 341, 762, 27230]. 2003-2005 (6 files, 3 seasons) NOT parsed: different pre-2006 layout (date-time string column '02月01日01時' in col0, station names in row0) - measured limitation, fixable by a layout-aware parser; 16 parsed seasons are sufficient for splits. Threshold base rates are high at 80 because the archive window is the Feb-June sugi season; construction should pick the threshold from the measured distribution (all six threshold counts recorded in the report).
measurements.taxon_semantics_2026_10_31: MOE press release 4673 (env.go.jp/press/4673.html, fetched 2026-10-31) documents the Hanako real-time and past download data as '花粉飛散データ（個数/m³）（当分の間 スギ花粉数）' with per-station 24-hour totals: the archive count column is publisher-documented as SUGI (Japanese cedar) pollen in grains/m3. Resolves the recorded next_action item (2); the '当分の間' caveat is moot for the terminated (2021-12-24) archive.

review: Five contracts reconciled 2026-10-31: redistribution SUPPORTED (PDL 1.0 quoted 2026-10-28, licence_class A), timing SUPPORTED for a labelled retrospective benchmark with the -9996 vintage caveat recorded (no historical-operational claim), target SUPPORTED (daily 24-hour sugi sum, taxon pinned from MOE press 4673, units grains/m3, missing codes documented in-file), split capacity SUPPORTED and MEASURED (16 seasons 2006-2021, thousands of valid station-days per season, positives at every recorded threshold in every season; clustered units = seasons), not-a-mirror SUPPORTED (novelty_check differentiated 2026-10-28). Carried into construction: 2003-2005 layout gap (excluded, fixable), threshold choice from the measured distribution, and the post-hoc-clean vintage restriction that keeps this a retrospective benchmark only.
next_action: READY -> hand to advancement. Construction: (1) decide the threshold and the censoring rule (valid day = 24/24 valid hourly values; censored days excluded, count recorded), and the trailing-window station-eligibility rule; (2) a layout-aware parser for the 2003-2005 files is optional - 16 seasons suffice; (3) build the station-day panel with paired AMEDAS weather features (AMEDAS files measured separately: 110 files, sample-proven pairing 2026-10-28), prediction instant 00:00 JST day t, features strictly <= t-1 23:59; (4) run the full pipeline: worker construction -> dataset-qualification gate on the full artifact -> exact-byte acceptance -> blind cross-row leakage joins -> baseline triad -> reporting. Deciding check: qualification gate green on the exact artifact plus blind-join AUC 1.0 absence on eval.

novelty_check.theirs: The publisher supplies raw historical archives and annual Durham-method season summaries (no task, no splits, no scored contract); academic users of the same data ship causal/descriptive analyses (NBER w31593, Tohoku DP TUPD-2026-010, Kawatsu 2019); closest ML prior art is single-city minimal datasets (Krakow OSF subset, Munich campaign, Luxembourg scraped unspecified-licence, Raleigh 433 records) and private Japanese forecast operators.
novelty_check.ours: A national multi-station, multi-season (2003/2008-2021) airborne-pollen station-day exceedance benchmark built from the MOE Hanako-san automatic-counter archive with the publisher's own paired AMEDAS weather features, chronological season splits, documented in-file censoring semantics and a PDL 1.0 redistribution path; no public packaged pollen prediction task exists on this or any national panel.
novelty_check.rule: A dataset that already exists in ML-ready form is not published. Mirroring is a failure mode, not a contribution.
